# Connected Commons

> Connected Commons is a boutique go-to-market (GTM) and business development consultancy based in Singapore, led by Ron Foo and supported by a network of specialist partners. It works with B2B software and tech companies in Singapore and Southeast Asia that have a working product and some paying customers, and need a repeatable way to find, reach and qualify buyers without building a full sales team first.

Connected Commons is a brand operated by RFtechstuff (UEN 53536160B), Singapore. Website: https://www.connectedcommons.co

## Key facts

- Who leads it: Ron Foo (also known as Foo Chuanrong), based in Singapore. More than 20 years in business development and operations across banking, real estate, logistics, software and outsourcing in Southeast Asia. Speaks English and Chinese.
- What it does: GTM strategy, pipeline build and fractional business development (BD) support for B2B tech companies.
- Where: Singapore, serving companies based in or selling into Singapore and Southeast Asia.
- How it works: people, process and AI. Ron leads the judgement calls (positioning, buyer conversations, partner introductions). A written GTM playbook sets the process. AI handles research, list building, first drafts and reporting, and a person reviews all outreach before it is sent.
- Pricing: no public price list. Each engagement is scoped on a short call.
- Not a fit: consumer (B2C) businesses, ideas without a working product, anyone seeking guaranteed lead numbers or pay-per-lead deals, and companies wanting a large outsourced sales floor.
- Connected Commons provides business consulting only. It does not provide legal, tax, accounting or financial advice, and it does not guarantee results.

## Services

- GTM Strategy: ideal customer profile and buyer roles, positioning and core messaging, channel priorities and a written GTM plan. Usually 3 to 6 weeks.
- Pipeline Build: named target-account and contact lists, outreach sequences for LinkedIn and email, CRM setup and qualification criteria. Usually 6 to 12 weeks.
- Fractional BD Support: part-time business development, including ongoing outreach and follow-up, partner and channel conversations, and pipeline reviews and reporting to leadership. Monthly, ongoing.
